record.summary: The deliverable image: one container running rauthy (loopback :8081) and the Encore app (:8080) under a die-together entrypoint, all durable state on a single /data volume, every secret self-provisioned at first boot. scripts/docker-build.sh builds from a clean git worktree of HEAD, injects the cross-built addon, the built SPA, and production node_modules, runs `encore build docker`, asserts the base-image entrypoint, and layers rauthy + the entrypoint on top.
record.title: Single-container packaging: app + rauthy in one image
